measurement_rule: A source-gap day is missing source coverage, never zero company attention. It contributes neither matched NUMARTS nor total NUMARTS to monthly attention denominators.
monthly_rule: Monthly company attention is sum(matched NUMARTS) / sum(total NUMARTS) over source-available days that are also inside the security's PIT alias interval.
next_if_pass: Close Stage 3L attention acquisition with documented source gaps and freeze the H3 statistical specification before any outcome join.
purpose: Resolve the complete set of unavailable daily GDELT GKG sources without treating source absence as zero attention and without discarding successful Stage 3L caches.

source_gap_classes.CATALOG_LISTED_BUT_UNDELIVERABLE_AFTER_R: Daily GKG filename is listed in the refreshed official catalog but remains unavailable after the frozen reconciliation retry sequence.
source_gap_classes.OFFICIAL_CATALOG_ABSENT_AND_DIRECT_UNAVA: Daily GKG filename is absent from the refreshed official GDELT GKG md5/filesize catalog union and a direct HTTPS/HTTP acquisition attempt also fails.
